results.answer: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard and open-source framework introduced by Anthropic in November 2024 to standardize the way artificial intelligence (AI) systems like large language models (LLMs) integrate and share data with external tools, systems, and data sources. MCP provides a standardized interface for reading files, executing functions, and handling contextual prompts. It addresses the problem of "Model Sprawl," where different AI systems could not communicate with each other or user data, solving the biggest issue in AI beyond intelligence itself. MCP enables AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT to connect to data sources (e.g., local files, databases), tools (e.g., search engines), and other systems, facilitating seamless integration and data sharing.
